mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS subjectId, s.subject_code AS subjectCode, s.subject_name AS subjectName, s.subject_type AS subjectType, s.balance_direction AS balanceDirection, s.is_leaf AS isLeaf, IFNULL(ib.init_debit, 0) AS initDebit, IFNULL(ib.init_credit, 0) AS initCredit, ib.update_time AS updateTime, ib.update_by AS updateBy FROM fin_subject s LEFT JOIN fin_init_balance ib ON s.id = ib.subject_id WHERE s.is_leaf = '1' AND s.status = '1' ORDER BY s.subject_code ASC

SELECT s.id AS subjectId, s.subject_code AS subjectCode, s.subject_name AS subjectName, IFNULL(ib.init_debit, 0) AS initDebit, IFNULL(ib.init_credit, 0) AS initCredit FROM fin_subject s LEFT JOIN fin_init_balance ib ON s.id = ib.subject_id WHERE s.subject_code = #{subjectCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_init_balance (subject_id, init_debit, init_credit, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{subjectId}, #{initDebit}, #{initCredit}, #{operator}, NOW(), #{operator}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE init_debit = #{initDebit}, init_credit = #{initCredit}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW()
